findings.title: include_website_name missing ? so filter is never called
findings.body: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb the serializer defines def include_website_name without a question mark. ActiveModel::Serializer checks include_<attr>? to decide whether to include an attribute, as used elsewhere in the same file for include_stats?, include_suspend_reason?, etc. Because the ? is missing the method is ignored, the website.present? guard is dead code, and website_name is always serialized even when website is blank or nil.

findings.title: website_name bypasses TL0 anonymous hiding for website
findings.body: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb website is listed in untrusted_attributes so it is hidden from anonymous viewers when scope.restrict_user_fields?(object) is true for TL0 users. website_name was added to attributes on line 43 but was not added to untrusted_attributes. As a result a TL0 user's website host plus path is still sent as website_name even when website itself is suppressed, leaking the private profile field the restriction is meant to hide.

findings.title: website_name drops port, query string and fragment
findings.body: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb website_name is built as website_host + URI(website.to_s).path in all three branches. That discards port, query string and fragment, so http://example.com/page?x=1#y and http://example.com:8080/page are both displayed as example.com/page. Two distinct user URLs become indistinguishable and the displayed text does not match the linked href, contrary to the stated goal of showing the complete path.

findings.title: Host comparison is case-sensitive
findings.body: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb website_host is compared to Discourse.current_hostname with == and ends_with? without downcasing. DNS hostnames are case-insensitive, so a user website like http://EXAMPLE.COM/foo on an instance at example.com will be treated as an external domain and shown without path, producing inconsistent display for the same host.

findings.title: Untrusted-attributes test omits website_name
findings.body: In spec/serializers/user_serializer_spec.rb the TL0 anonymous test lists bio_raw, bio_cooked, bio_excerpt, location, website, profile_background, card_background but not website_name. It therefore cannot catch that website_name is still serialized for TL0 users seen as anonymous while website is hidden.
